title: The max of two constructed reals is at least the left one
statement: For constructed reals x0, x1: x0 <= max(x0, x1).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.le_max_left : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> CReal.le x0 (CReal.max x0 x1)))

evidence.supports: CReal.le_max_left is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
